title: Guarded Admin maintenance controls
summary: Added a permission-gated Admin recovery console for auditable Laravel maintenance activation, deactivation, and partial-failure reconciliation.
changes: Added database-backed maintenance-window history with a cross-database single-current-window guard and bounded failure details.
Added branded HTML and sanitized JSON maintenance responses while preserving health, staff authentication, and authorized Admin recovery routes.
Protected native maintenance transitions with atomic locks and made deployment and rollback controls preserve pre-existing operator maintenance.
affected_areas: Admin operations, recovery routing, health reporting, deployment and rollback controls
version_rationale: A backward-compatible minor release adding the guarded operational capability planned in issue #16.
validation: Authorization, confirmations, concurrency, native and history partial failures, reconciliation, branded responses, OIDC recovery, health reporting, and deployment ownership are covered.
known_limitations: Planned end times are informational only; maintenance restoration remains an explicit authorized operation.
rollback: Compatible rollback preserves the authoritative Redis-backed Laravel maintenance state. Releases without the Admin console retain emergency recovery through the Laravel CLI.
provenance: Defined by the guarded Admin maintenance-control work for MyAPES Account issue #16.
